changeSet.author: cpn
changeSet.comment: Lúc khách chuyển khoản OnePay đủ cước đơn app (tính doanh thu như đơn đã nhập kho, huỷ không trừ).

changeSet.author: cpn
changeSet.comment: Chuyển khoản qua OnePay SANDBOX (đơn test): huỷ thì không giữ doanh thu.

changeSet.author: cpn
changeSet.sql: update shipment_order set transfer_paid_at = ( select max(i.paid_at) from onepay_invoice i where i.purpose = 'ORDER' and i.state = 'PAID' and (i.order_code = shipment_order.order_code or i.order_code = shipment_order.draft_code) ) where transfer_paid_at is null and exists ( select 1 from onepay_invoice i where i.purpose = 'ORDER' and i.state = 'PAID' and (i.order_code = shipment_order.order_code or i.order_code = shipment_order.draft_code) )

changeSet.author: cpn
changeSet.comment: Đơn cũ: coi là test nếu thu hộ chưa chuyển sang PRODUCTION.
changeSet.sql: update shipment_order set transfer_sandbox = ( case when exists (select 1 from onepay_config c where c.environment = 'PRODUCTION') then false else true end ) where transfer_paid_at is not null and transfer_sandbox is null
